slices.statement: An installed profile resolves sync credentials through the operating system's store, and a mobile target links none of it

items.title: Complete the journey catalogues, and give the GUI an inventory

slices.statement: The interface can tag and untag a note, with a captured journey
The command line can delete and restore a note
A control crawl enumerates the interface by state and pins what it finds
The pinned inventory cannot go stale unnoticed: an interface signature fails validation when a control is added without re-crawling
The desktop harness captures the four journeys a browser cannot reach
Saving stays explicit and the unsaved draft is protected, including when the window closes

Write GUI journeys for the twelve features that have an interface surface and none: collections, attachments, remote media, links, graph, query blocks, sync pairing, sync exchange, sync peers, sync recovery, jobs and profiles
Work down the eighteen features with no command-line journey, which the ratchet tracks
Decide how much of the query language one journey should demonstrate, and whether interface journeys should point at command-line-only tasks

items.title: Reconcile the collection model with what is actually stored

slices.statement: Answer what a collection is, and what kind, capabilities, deletion and --collection mean
An unspecified collection means every collection wherever a read is scoped, and --collection narrows rather than presumes
Remove kind and capabilities from api.Collection, the OpenAPI schema and MCP list_collections, and the three columns that never existed from DATABASE_SCHEMA.md
Decide whether a dangling collection identifier is repaired by adopting the note into default or by recreating the missing row, and what schema precondition that repair requires
Decide whether a collection's name and description stay editable, and write the route if they do
Decide whether the breaking response-shape change ships in v0.8

items.title: Act on many notes at once, from the search results and from a query

slices.statement: The interface selects more than one search result and offers the operations that apply to a set
The command line names a set by query, shows the selection, and then acts on it
Decide whether the command grows notriosctl batch or the existing commands grow --query, and whether the interface uses request_key

items.title: Make the features page usable, and generate the table under it

slices.statement: The capability catalogue renders as prose sections rather than as bullets with bracketed scores
A capability-by-surface table is generated from the same registry, with the shared-library column refused a claim it cannot verify
A heading a generator emitted is graded generated rather than unverified, in the inventory and in the audit
Rewrite the twenty-nine summaries and surface notes in FEATURES.json for a reader rather than against the surfaces

items.title: notriosctl search

slices.statement: A read-only search command takes the query language and prints hits a person can read
--json emits each hit with its stable link, and --limit reports the cursor for the next page
Decide what --count does, given that the store returns hits and a cursor and no total
A command-line journey finds a note and acts on the id the search returned

items.title: v0.8 release wrap-up and branch synchronization

slices.statement: Reconcile every v0.8 item's evidence and archive the completed ones
Synchronise develop and main and record the release state

items.title: Bring the atlas current, and stop it drifting again

slices.statement: The atlas describes what each complete v0.8 item added, in the terms the rest of the map uses
A package under internal/ or cmd/ with no atlas entry fails a build
The atlas's root-document list is generated from the document registry rather than kept in parallel
The chronological additions sections are resolved, so a reader looks up a path rather than a date

items.title: Read a note and its structure, from the command line

slices.statement: The command line prints a note as Markdown with the front matter Notrios already writes, or as JSON, to a file or to standard output
The command line lists what is attached to a note and writes one attachment's bytes to a file
The command line lists a note's links and its outline
The documentation says what reading a note already offers on REST and MCP, and stops claiming reading has no command line

items.title: Discover the values a query can name

slices.statement: The command line lists and shows collections, which today can only be created as a side effect of an import
The command line's notebook listing gives the ids a query takes, in JSON as well as for a reader
The documentation says how to find a notebook or collection and then scope a search with it, and names the REST and MCP equivalents

items.title: One description of the command line, and --help everywhere

slices.statement: One registry in code declares every command, its purpose, its flags and its arguments, and the dispatcher reads it
--help and -h work at the top level, on a command group and on a subcommand, print the same shape, and exit 0
A dispatched subcommand missing from the registry fails a build, or is exempt with a stated reason
The surface inventory and the published CLI guide are derived from the registry rather than from a help string literal
Tools can discover the command line as data through notriosctl help --json
The unclaimed-surface baseline and the features registry reflect the real command line
